sources.label: NPS Buffalo National River river-access list and mileage chart
sources.supports: Identifies Erbie as a designated Buffalo River put-in/take-out and gives mileage context for the river-access chain.
sources.doesNotSupport: Does not provide exact coordinates for the water-entry point.

sources.label: NPS Erbie campground/access coordinate and general travel guidance
sources.supports: Publishes the Erbie campground/access-area coordinate 36.0703459086,-93.2118858701 and warns GPS can be unreliable in the park.
sources.doesNotSupport: The point is an access-area/campground anchor and does not claim to mark the water-entry edge.

sources.label: Current Google Maps aerial imagery at the Buffalo River Erbie access
sources.supports: Visible campground approach and its connection to the Buffalo River edge.
sources.doesNotSupport: Aerial imagery does not establish public access independently or provide survey accuracy; NPS establishes public-site identity.

sources.label: USGS National Hydrography Dataset route-coordinate audit
sources.supports: Mapped waterbody proximity and named flowline offset for the published point and imagery-derived landing.
sources.doesNotSupport: Generalized centerlines do not replace local landing surveys.

coordinateMethod: Aerial imagery estimate at the visible public river landing, checked against mapped water; approximately 75 ft uncertainty. Not surveyed.
